title: Twilight
description: A high-school student is caught up in a romance with a vampire, whose family has renounced the drinking of human blood.

title: The Twilight Saga: New Moon
description: After the abrupt departure of Edward, her vampire love, Bella finds comfort in her deepening friendship with Jacob Black. However, Bella's loyalties are put to the test as she becomes drawn into the world of werewolves, ancient enemies of vampires.

title: The Twilight Saga: Eclipse
description: Bella must choose between Edward and Jacob amid a string of mysterious killings and a malicious vampire's quest for revenge.

title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn Part 1
description: A chain of events, set off by Edward and Bella's marriage, honeymoon and birth of a child, yields a shocking development for Jacob.

title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn Part 2
description: Bella and Edward gather werewolves, vampires and other allies to help them protect their daughter from the Volturi.

title: Northmen: A Viking Saga
description: Shipwrecked in a strange land, marauding Vikings must battle a band of mercenaries after kidnapping the daughter of a Scottish king.

title: Viking Destiny
description: A Viking princess is forced to flee her kingdom when she is framed for her father's murder. Under the guidance of the god Odin, she travels far and wide to gather support to win back her throne.

title: Solomon Kane
description: A man (James Purefoy) must renounce his newly taken vows of peace to rescue a young woman (Rachel Hurd-Wood) from an evil sorcerer (Jason Flemyng).

title: Highlander II: Renegade Version
description: Immortal Scottish swordsmen (Christopher Lambert, Sean Connery) from another planet return, this time with an environmental terrorist (Virginia Madsen).

title: Highlander: The Source
description: Duncan MacLeod and a group of companions embark on a quest to discover the origin of their immortality.

title: Three Musketeers
description: The disbanded Musketeers reunite to defeat a beautiful double agent and the scheming man she is working for.

title: Hellboy
description: Legendary half-demon Hellboy encounters an ancient resurrected sorceress who's out to avenge a past betrayal. Caught in a clash between the supernatural and the human, Hellboy becomes hell-bent on stopping her without triggering the end of the world.

title: The Legend of Hercules
description: Betrayed by his stepfather, the King, and exiled and sold into slavery because of a forbidden love, Hercules must use his formidable powers to fight his way back to his rightful kingdom.

title: Voyagers
description: With the future of the human race at stake, a group of young men and women embark on an expedition to colonize a distant planet. As life on the ship descends into chaos, they soon become consumed by fear, lust and an insatiable hunger for power.
